chapters.title: Martin Taylor's Complete Jazz Guitar Method Compilation
chapters.notes: OCR front matter contained only storefront/marketing metadata with no usable TOC or chapter headings. Body OCR is sparse (~206 chars/page) and surfaces no recoverable chapter markers. Per spec fallback rule, treating the compilation as a single chapter spanning all 408 pages. The book is known to compile three sub-volumes — Chord-Melody, Walking Basslines, Single-Note Soloing — but OCR does not expose those internal boundaries.
